messages:
Maya: Morning team — new cpt1 region bring-up starting 09:00 UTC. Running a 2h preflight window (09:00–11:00). I’ll kick off smoke tests, routing checks, and a short perf run. @AJ can you confirm GPU quota and driver image status? @ops-bot will post automated probes.
ops-bot: [auto-checks] control-plane=OK (kube-apiserver 3/3), etcd=OK, kernel/drivers=DEGRADED (nvidia-driver: 535.54 installed on 6/8 nodes), network=OK (vpc-peering established), iptables/NAT=OK.
AJ: Quota confirmed — 64 A100s total, 6 reserved for infra, 58 available to workloads. Image registry sync completed. Two nodes failed driver install due to kernel mismatch (expected 5.19, current 5.15). Scheduled driver update at 09:15.
Tom: DNS: api.cpt1.redwood.local -> 10.5.0.12 propagated. Peering RTT to core ~28ms. Ran iperf3 cpt1-primary <-> sfo1 avg 1600Mbps. Egress rules: nat-gw in place, 0.0.0.0/0 blocked for infra but allowed via NAT.
Nelson: Quick smoke notes: kubectl get nodes -o wide -> all Ready except gpu-node-07 NotReady. nvidia-smi on gpu-node-07 shows NVML init error. Rebooted, still failing. Suspect kernel/driver mismatch.
Irina: For SLO gates let's be strict: control-plane error rate < 5% (apiserver), node GPU readiness >= 95%, p95 pod start < 5s for infra pods, cross-region peering RTT < 150ms, egress throughput >= 1Gbps baseline. If any gate fails we abort handoff.
SRE Lead: Agreed. Add model-serving sanity: run a small model on 4 GPUs and verify token latency < 120ms at 8 concurrent streams (seq=256). Use perf harness below.
SRE Lead: ```bash
# perf harness quick run
./perf_harness --region cpt1 --model gpt-mini --gpus 4 --concurrency 8 --seq 256 --duration 60
# success criteria: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 120ms, error_rate < 1%
```
Maya: Kicking off the perf harness at 09:40. I'll also run KV cache warmup and prefix-caching checks. Cost note: initial week targeted spot mix ~40% — expect ~15–20% unit cost reduction; we'll export actuals to cost-export for review.
AJ: Driver patch deployed to the two problematic nodes at 09:18, rebooted. Both returned Ready. Re-ran nvidia-smi -> GPUs visible, NVML OK.
ops-bot: perf_harness started 09:40:32. Intermediate metrics: p50=48ms, p95=89ms, errors=0.6%. iperf3 ongoing: sustained 1.2Gbps.
Tom: Network egress check completed: nat-gw throughput 1.3Gbps, connection-tracking at 12% capacity, no NAT exhaustion.
Nelson: Final smoke: ingress (nginx) healthy, certs valid, failover route53 records tested, canary traffic (10 rps) -> responses 200.
Irina: All SLO gates are satisfied. One remaining check: DB replica lag — currently 2s (within 5s threshold).
SRE Lead: Good. Handoff: @oncall please pick up post-bring-up operations. Docs are in /runbooks/regions/cpt1-handoff. Tag region status as 'cpt1-green' in the console. No post-mortem needed. Bring-up complete timestamp: 10:12 UTC.
Maya: Thanks everyone :tada: I’ll update the region status and flip monitoring retention to 90d per enterprise policy. Closing thread.
